decision.reason: [ev-0483f04624d3] and [ev-43cc6d389282] establish that exposure is having set -boltdb.shipper.shared-store / -tsdb.shipper.shared-store or 'their corresponding YAML setting'. The proposed values-key paths (boltdb.shipper.shared-store, tsdb.shipper.shared-store) are not named anywhere in the evidence. The overlap (the negation of the exposure) is too broad because it flags environments that never touch the subject. The evidence does not give the YAML/Helm values path or ConfigMap key of the shared_store setting, so a complete corrected exposure cannot be written without guessing. Note that index loss applies only on a mismatch with object_store [ev-7d2769e8c602][ev-af5a4b32c120].
